remainingRisks: The Forget association in this case is written by the seed directly (fixture state naming the target messages), not created by the product's own Forget action. The run verifies only that the history path excludes associated sources, not that a real Forget would have associated them.
The working tree had uncommitted changes; the commit alone does not identify the code that ran.
Timings are CLI network observations, not browser rendering times (T08 #321 covers the browser).
